tools.name: call_tool
tools.title: Call Tool
tools.description: Call a tool by name, including tools that registered after you connected and aren't in your tool list. Find tools and their input schemas with search_tools.

name.description: The tool to call, as named by search_tools.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema, as a json object. Omit for tools that take none.

tools.name: run_csharp
tools.title: Run
tools.description: Run a trusted C# method body on the engine main thread in game scope. Supply code OR an absolute path to a UTF-8 script file. Supports await and return (object); System, System.Linq, System.Threading, System.Threading.Tasks and Sandbox are imported. Parameters exchangeDirectory and cancellationToken are available. Example: return Game.ActiveScene?.Name; Engine/editor APIs are available, with editor types fully qualified. This has full local process privileges, may mutate live state, and does not create undo steps. Cancellation is cooperative: check cancellationToken in loops. Discover this tool through search_tools.

code.description: C# method body to execute. Mutually exclusive with path.

path.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 C# method body, usually in the session exchange directory.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search Tools
tools.description: Search the live tool registry. Tools live in editor and addon code and come and go as code hotloads, so the tool list from when you connected can be stale - this one never is. Every keyword must match the name, description or parameters; empty returns every tool. Invoke anything you find with call_tool.

query.description: Space separated keywords. Empty for every tool.
